This operation is initiated by bios.   What does this property actually do in this implementation?  I suspect as defined, this can just be hardcoded to Enabled?

In CredentialBootStrapping there are two properties "EnabledAfterReset" and "Enabled". DSP0270 detailed the case when these values are changed:

"Upon normal completion of this command, the Enabled property within the CredentialBootstrapping
property of the host interface resource shall be set to false , unless the "disable credential
bootstrapping control" parameter of the command contains the value A5h."

"If the EnableAfterReset property within the CredentialBootstrapping property of the host interface
resource is true , services shall set the Enabled property within the CredentialBootstrapping property
of the host interface resource to true :
• On any reset of the service.
• On any reset of the host."

So I don't think we can hardcode them.

In the other patch set with the same topic, I added on option to set the default value of EnabledAfterReset when the phosphor-user-manager or BMC is reset.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-user-manager/+/82360/4/meson.options
